hero.t: I turn real operational problems into software used every day.
hero.b:
I built the ERP for Confecções Botezini, used daily: quotes that took around 20–30 minutes now take 2–5.

React and TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, 619 automated tests across both stores, and AI built into the development process.

sobre.b:
I study Physics at UFSJ and Systems Analysis and Development at Estácio, and I have been coding for about a year.

I learn by building: real problems in quoting, production, inventory and finance become systems used in operations.

I use AI to speed up investigation and implementation; my job is to break the problem down, give context, test the result and own it.

erp.b:
Management system used by Confecções Botezini: quotes, orders, production, inventory, finance.

items.t: Under the hood of the ERP

items.n: From quote to finance on the same base: what is sold goes into production and consumes inventory.
Counted straight from the repository.

items.code:
const fabricCostTotal = fabricCostPerM * calcFabricM
const overheadCost = fabricCostTotal * (calcOverhead / 100)
const laborHoursPerPiece = (calcWorkers * 8) / piecesDay
const laborCostPerPiece = laborHoursPerPiece * calcLaborRate

const cmvBase = fabricCostTotal + overheadCost + laborCostPerPiece
const cmvCalculated = cmvBase + cmvBase * (calcTaxRate / 100)
const suggestedPrice = cmvCalculated * calcMarkup
items.n: The suggested price comes from real cost: fabric at inventory average cost, overhead, labor from the factory daily capacity, taxes and margin.
Each approved order becomes a production order and moves through the factory stages. The "factory" profile only sees this screen.
Every stock entry recalculates the weighted average cost in a trigger, with the row locked (FOR UPDATE) so two simultaneous movements cannot corrupt inventory.
Payables and receivables are kept apart from payments. A wrong payment is reversed with a date, not deleted: the history stays auditable.

items.code:
projected balance = balance in banks
                  + open receivables
                  − open payables
-- a reversed payment is not deleted: it gets reversed_at
-- and leaves the sum (FILTER WHERE reversed_at IS NULL)
items.n: Reconciliation crosses banks, open bills and active payments. When the projected balance did not match, the system got a script that redoes the math to find the gap.

metodo.b: This portfolio is the example: under 150 lines of JavaScript, no libraries, and a method for working with AI without losing control of the code.

in.numl: lines of JavaScript on this site, zero libraries
in.prob: Animated 3D portfolios usually weigh megabytes and become code nobody maintains.
dec: Camera driven by a damped spring: the harmonic oscillator from Physics
Animation in real-time steps: same speed at 30 or 120 fps
Images in two resolutions: light preview, full size only when the camera arrives
Motion-free mode for anyone with "reduce motion" on

items.t: Under the hood of this site

items.n: Four lines: the camera gains speed toward the target and loses part of it every frame. It overshoots a little and settles.

items.code:
# Índice (caminho | função | depende de)
CLAUDE.md | regras para IA
TODO.md | pendências, dívidas, estudo
index.html | livro, quadros, legenda
main.js | câmera, capítulos, i18n
content/*.json | todos os textos
items.n: The AI reads the index and opens only the files for the task: less context, less cost, fewer mistakes.
